description: 暗夜竞技风头戴降噪耳机套图：白卡总览+波纹降噪+续航+折叠+规格背书

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal-navy seamless studio backdrop alternating with pure white rounded info cards and light-grey detail tiles
styleLock.lightingSystem: low-key cool rim light for dark hero shots, bright even high-key for light-background shots, soft contact shadows, single light direction per shot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark cube pedestal and seamless studio floor
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; red capsule underline accents
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line black icons on white cards with red accent marks, uniform stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: product centered and stable; 3/4 or front hero angle on dark shots; high 45-degree overhead for structure shots; consistent scale across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: premium athletic-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal-navy background #1A1D24, pure white info cards #FFFFFF, light grey #F5F5F6, and a single vivid red accent #D42B1F; neutral-cool studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded-corner white info cards on dark background; consistent thin-line icons with red accent marks; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 9 片 800x1200 详情长图切片提炼；主产品为头戴式无线蓝牙降噪耳机（红黑配色），L2 判为耳机音频，与源文件夹『耳机』一致。已剥离千图/QIANTU 水印、LOGO 标记与页尾会员二维码；源图填充用假参数（120*60*30CM、蓝牙5.0、50米、400AM、24h）与重复示例文案全部转为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽由使用方填写；源规格表『佩戴方式：入耳式』与实物不符，以图为准按头戴式处理；纯信息卡镜（shot-05/07）不渲染产品。
